questiontext.text: What applied science focuses on designing computer equipment and workspaces to fit the natural physiological needs of the human body?

questiontext.text: What medical term describes painful disorders of muscles, nerves, and tendons caused by repetitive motions and awkward postures during computer use?

questiontext.text: Which severe form of RSI involves the painful compression of the median nerve within the wrist, causing numbness and tingling in the hand?

generalfeedback.text: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome (CTS) occurs when the median nerve is compressed as it passes through the wrist's carpal tunnel, causing pain and numbness.

questiontext.text: What does the ergonomic "20-20-20 Rule" instruct a computer user to do?

generalfeedback.text: The 20-20-20 rule recommends looking away from the screen every 20 minutes at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax eye muscles.

answer.text: Every 20 minutes, look at an object 20 feet away for at least 20 seconds

feedback.text: Correct! The 20-20-20 rule recommends looking away from the screen every 20 minutes at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax eye muscles.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The 20-20-20 rule recommends looking away from the screen every 20 minutes at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax eye muscles.

questiontext.text: Why do computer users frequently experience dry, burning eyes when staring at a monitor screen?

generalfeedback.text: Concentrated screen focus reduces human blinking from 15–20 times per minute down to 5 times per minute, leading to rapid dry eye syndrome.

answer.text: Users blink significantly less frequently when focused on digital screens, causing natural eye moisture to evaporate

feedback.text: Correct! Concentrated screen focus reduces human blinking from 15–20 times per minute down to 5 times per minute, leading to rapid dry eye syndrome.

answer.text: Computer screens emit hot steam directly into the user's face

feedback.text: Incorrect. Concentrated screen focus reduces human blinking from 15–20 times per minute down to 5 times per minute, leading to rapid dry eye syndrome.

answer.text: Microprocessors absorb moisture directly out of the air

feedback.text: Incorrect. Concentrated screen focus reduces human blinking from 15–20 times per minute down to 5 times per minute, leading to rapid dry eye syndrome.

answer.text: Computer cooling fans blow exhaust air straight into the user's eyes

feedback.text: Incorrect. Concentrated screen focus reduces human blinking from 15–20 times per minute down to 5 times per minute, leading to rapid dry eye syndrome.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are common symptoms associated with Computer Vision Syndrome (CVS)? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Burning eyes, dryness, blurred vision, and headaches are classic symptoms of CVS. Knee swelling is unrelated.

questiontext.text: Which of the following ergonomic practices help prevent Repetitive Strain Injuries (RSI)? (Select two)

generalfeedback.text: Neutral wrist alignment and regular stretch breaks prevent tendon inflammation and nerve compression.
